projects.title: Digital Inventory & Stock Management App
projects.description: Web-based inventory management featuring real-time Data Barang tracking and Stok Opname auditing.

detail.longDescription: A comprehensive web-based inventory management system designed for small-to-medium businesses. The application provides real-time tracking of product stock levels, automated low-stock alerts, and a full Stok Opname (stock audit) workflow that compares physical counts with system records. The backend is powered by Native with a well-structured MySQL schema, while the frontend delivers a clean, responsive UI built with BootstrapCSS.
highlights: Real-time stock tracking with automatic update on every transaction
Full Stok Opname (audit) module with discrepancy reporting
Role-based access control — Admin, Gudang, and Viewer roles
PDF & Excel export for audit reports
Responsive dashboard with stock summary charts
Equipped with demand forecasts of future supply requirements

projects.title: Digital Library Document Management System (Unhas)
projects.description: Web-based academic document archive for Universitas Hasanuddin — managing S1 Skripsi, S2 Tesis, and S3 Disertasi with PDF storage, multi-filter search, and role-based access.

detail.longDescription: A full-featured academic library management system developed for Universitas Hasanuddin. The platform centralizes the archival and retrieval of academic documents — S1 Skripsi, S2 Tesis, and S3 Disertasi — across all faculties and study programs. Administrators can upload original PDF files, manage document metadata, and generate formatted print reports. The system features dynamic AJAX-powered dropdowns for faculty-to-study-program selection, advanced multi-criteria filtering, and a statistics dashboard with chart visualizations. Role-based access control (RBAC) built with Spatie Laravel Permission ensures that each user role (Admin, Staff TU) can only perform authorized actions.
highlights: PDF file upload & download with secure server-side storage
Advanced multi-filter search by Faculty, Study Program, Year, and Document Type
Dashboard analytics with charts — distribution by year, faculty, and program
Export to XLSX/XLS/CSV/HTML & bulk import from Excel (Maatwebsite Excel)
Print-ready PDF reports — full list and individual document (DomPDF)
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) using Spatie Laravel Permission
Dynamic AJAX dropdown — Program Studi updates automatically per Faculty
Covers S1 Skripsi, S2 Tesis, and S3 Disertasi with unique document codes

projects.title: FishingHub - Platform Komunitas Pemancing Indonesia
projects.description: Platform web komunitas pemancing berbasis Native PHP & MySQL yang dilengkapi peta spot interaktif, forum diskusi, galeri tangkapan, artikel, dan manajemen event.

detail.longDescription:
FishingHub adalah platform komunitas digital serba ada yang dirancang khusus untuk para penggemar memancing (angler) di Indonesia. Dibangun dari nol menggunakan Native PHP dan database MySQL dengan arsitektur berkinerja tinggi tanpa ketergantungan framework berat.

Aplikasi ini menyediakan sistem peta interaktif berbasis Leaflet.js untuk pemetaan spot memancing darat dan laut secara real-time lengkap dengan sistem rating. Selain itu, pengguna dapat berdiskusi di forum komunitas, berbagi foto hasil tangkapan di galeri masonry, membaca artikel tips teknik & peralatan, serta mendaftar event dan turnamen memancing. Dilengkapi juga dengan Admin Panel lengkap untuk administrasi pengguna, postingan, dan moderasi konten.
highlights: Interactive Fishing Spot Map
Custom Ocean-Themed Design System
Multi-Feature Community Hub
Admin Dashboard Panel
Secure Architecture

projects.title: Smart Sawit — Manajemen Perkebunan Kelapa Sawit Digital
projects.description: Aplikasi mobile smart farming berbasis Flutter dengan arsitektur offline-first dan integrasi GIS untuk mendigitalisasi operasional, perawatan, panen, dan keuangan perkebunan kelapa sawit secara end-to-end.

detail.longDescription: Smart Sawit adalah aplikasi mobile smart farming yang dirancang untuk mendigitalisasi seluruh siklus operasional perkebunan kelapa sawit — mulai dari pemetaan lahan, perawatan tanaman, pencatatan panen, hingga analisis keuangan. Dibangun dengan arsitektur Offline-First, aplikasi ini tetap berfungsi penuh di daerah perkebunan tanpa sinyal internet. Semua data disimpan ke SQLite lokal terlebih dahulu, lalu disinkronkan otomatis ke backend Laravel saat koneksi tersedia melalui mekanisme Upsert berbasis UUID untuk mencegah duplikasi.
highlights: Pemetaan GIS Interaktif
Arsitektur Offline-First
Weather Gate (BMKG Integration)
Otomasi Rotasi Panen
Manajemen Inventory Pupuk
